clips.title: The story
paras: Warsong Saw Blades keep the Horde's lumber machinery cutting in Ashenvale. The Warsong Clan relies on goblin-made machines for its logging, and these blades supply its clear-cutting work.

In Ashenvale, the Warsong Clan's logging depends on heavy machinery supplied and maintained by goblin engineers. Axes alone cannot meet the Horde's demand for Kalimdor lumber, so steam engines and circular saws cut through raw timber. Ashenvale's ancient hardwood quickly dulls and breaks ordinary blades. Replacement saw blades must keep arriving for the mills at the Warsong Lumber Camp to keep running.

Getting mechanical parts through disputed territory brings constant trouble. Hostile furbolgs and satyrs often intercept other logging supplies, while goblin contacts such as Pixel at Splintertree Post handle the saw blade shipments. Lumber master Locke Okarr gathers the blades with rope, oil, and axes to keep the camp operating despite sabotage from Ashenvale's defenders.
